android.desc:
The Best Stocks App for Stock Market

⭐JStock - Stocks,Stock Market,Portfolio,Investment⭐ makes it easy to track stocks, stock market, stock, stocks investment, portfolio, stock portfolio. It provides well organized stock market information, to help you decide your best investment strategy. You might always have an app from your stock brokerage. However, most stock brokerage app doesn't have a good portfolio tracker feature. JStock does have a great portfolio tracker and dividend tracker features. You may use JStock as a supplement app besides your brokerage app. JStock stock tracker feature lets you gain accurate and rich stock market information, even you have not yet opened any brokerage account. A very good stock tracker tool to help you equip yourself with the right stock market knowledge before you decide to begin your stock investment journey. JStock stocks app integrates seamless with JStock Desktop. Free and open source stock market software JStock Desktop can be downloaded separately from https://jstock.org

Stocks Features

🇺🇸 Monitor stocks from 28 world stock markets 💵 Stocks portfolio management for different stock market 💰Receive dividend from stocks and manage using stock market dividend management 📈 10 years stocks history chart 📊 Annualized yield from stock market via performance chart 📰 Read stock market news. Always up to latest stocks investment opportunity 👀 Home widgets for stocks watchlist, world stocks indices, and buy stocks portfolio. Always have a quick glance at stock market and stocks investment info 🌎 Keep track of stocks world indices 🛎️ Receive stock market alert when stock price moves above threshold or stock price moves below the threshold 📝 Write down stocks investment notes. You will never miss any stocks investment idea 📉 Draw stocks technical analysis on stocks chart. SMA and EMA at this moment. 🎀 Beautiful light & dark theme UI makes stocks app looks awesome 🔒 Startup lock screen to protect your stocks information ☁️ Cloud storage integration with Desktop JStock - Free Stock Market Software so that you will not miss any stocks information 💰 Great stocks portfolio summary chart to keep track stocks holding from stock market 💰 Stocks dividend chart to keep track of received stocks dividend from stock market 🔎 Zoom tool for stocks history cha

quotes.text: Hey everyone, I've been working on my app for the past few weeks and I've updated it with a new cleaner UI, added Google+ card liked UI for stock news feature, and a ton of bug fixes and tuneups. The next thing I'm working on is stock market news from Twitter feed. Let me know what you all think!
